scope: Identify the darkest line in the owner's legacy six-moving-average indicator from already-read Notion source excerpts.
access_method: Read-only Notion fetch of two pages linked from 交易系统-更新中 (2ac8856479af8063b17bc02256e564a9).
line_number_semantics: One-based line positions in the enhanced Markdown text field returned by the Notion fetch tool in this research session. These are not local-file line numbers, Notion block IDs, or immutable source permalinks.

finding.basis: Both pages default maPeriod1 to 20 and compute sma20 from close. Both draw SMA20 with opaque color.black at width 2, while EMA20 is color.black at 50% transparency and width 1. SMA60 is blue and SMA120 is purple.
finding.interpretation_limit: The exact color-to-series mapping in these source defaults is established. Inferring that the owner's current phrase 'the darkest line before' refers to this legacy palette remains contextual; live chart input/style overrides were not inspected in this subtask.
finding.retest_frequency_evidence: No statistical evidence or explicit universal rule that dense formations usually or always retest SMA20 was found in the inspected pages. Color identity is not evidence of retest frequency or profitability.

excluded_system.reason: This belongs to the separately documented Moving Average Shift / two-key-candle system, whose line dynamically uses teal or orange. It is not the legacy six-moving-average black SMA20.

provenance_limits.note: Only actually read short excerpts and their returned-text positions are recorded. No full-source completeness claim or fabricated source hash is included.
